verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
In the cool of the day
You come and meet me

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All the blue fades away
The stars are winking

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Your love's so strong
I can't recall

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
What was this thing
They called the fall?

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And You walk with me
You never leave
You're making my heart a garden

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Oh, why would I hide
Away from Your face

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
When the light of Your love
Illuminates?

verse.name: p2a
verse.lines:
Your hand in mine
A steady line

verse.name: p2b
verse.lines:
Drawn on my heart
And deep in my mind

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
All the broken are mending
The mournful rejoicing
Seeing through tears
Of peace overflowing
